en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whenever one of you retires to his bed, so let him say, ‘O Allahazwj! I have retained my soul with Youazwj, therefore Withhold it in a place of Yourazwj Pleasure and Yourazwj Forgiveness, and if you return it to my body, so return it as a Momin, a recogniser of the rights of Yourazwj Guardiansasws until You Cause him to die upon that’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad in a marfu’ manner from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

When any of you is about to go to your bed you should say, ‘O Lord, I have placed my soul in Your custody, keep it secure in a place that You like, and forgive, and if You return it to my body, return it with belief, and with knowledge of the rights of Your friends until it will die upon such belief.’”
